verdicts.evidence: All six tiles are flat colour blocks (red, green, blue, ochre, yellow, purple) with a lighter centred half-circle and no garden photographs, though the hues look somewhat muted rather than fully saturated.

The Herb bed caption starts about 9 px below its image and ends about 15 px above the Pond edge tile, and the Rose arch subtitle ends about 15 px above the bottom-row tiles, so the captions sit nearly as close to the next tile as to their own.
